counterfactual_missing_items: No fungal hyphae or angioinvasion on histopathology
No granulomatous inflammation or steroid-response history for Tolosa-Hunt
No organism identified on pathology despite positive sinus culture
decisive_items: Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells, with most being IgG4 positive
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone, with extension of inflammation into the apex
response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate that integrates the elevated serum IgG4, the dense IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltrate, and the sinonasal/orbital apex involvement. R2 explains the imaging findings but lacks fungal elements and is contradicted by Streptococcus culture. R1 and R4 fail to account for the IgG4 pathology. C1 is a correlated completion of R3 without independent raw support.

rejected.why: Imaging supports invasive sinusitis, but pathology shows IgG4-positive plasma cells and culture grows Streptococcus, not fungus; no fungal elements are described.
Positive Streptococcus culture does not explain orbital apex erosion, vision loss, or the IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltrate.
Orbital apex inflammation and painful vision loss fit, but sinus opacification, elevated IgG4, and IgG4-positive plasma cells are unexplained.
Correlated restatement of R3 with added anatomy; lacks independent raw support for the IgG4 diagnosis and is redundant.
